# 1ACP — native Agent sessions in DeepSeek Harness
1ACP 发布页 · npm package · 变更日志
Use Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build and other locally discovered ACP Agents inside DeepSeek Harness (
DSH). Continue persistent native sessions, choose the models and settings exposed by each Agent, and
handle tool permissions in DSH's approval UI. The same **`@1agents/acp-service`** package also prov
ides a standalone CLI and ACP HTTP/WebSocket service.

- Keep the native Agent's workspace, tools and session identity when reconnecting.
- Select native m

odels, reasoning settings, modes and advertised slash commands from the session UI.
- Optionally con

tinue native history with `@1agents/session-reader`.
- Enable A2A 1.0 task delegation, status querie
s and completion callbacks when needed. A2A is off by default; waking a caller's main Agent requires
its receiving host adapter.
## Install in DSH
Requires **Node.js 22.13+**, DSH, and the native Agent CLI with working authentication on the DSH ho
st. Adapter-backed Agents also need their ACP adapter; installing the native Codex CLI alone does no
t install `codex-acp`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH, confirm **`@1agents/acp-service`** is enabled on the Plugins page, then create a sessio
n with an **ACP · Agent** preset and an existing workspace. The plugin starts or reuses its local AC
P service automatically. Replace `web` with your profile name; from a DSH source checkout, use `pnpm
dsh` in place of `dsh`.
If pnpm reports an ignored `esbuild` build script, follow its prompt or configure that package's app
roval in the profile, then repeat the install. Approve or deny the individual script according to yo
ur policy. Check the Plugins page afterward: a partial install can leave the bundle disabled.
For a pinned release artifact, install the identical npm tarball attached to 0.6.0:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Install `@1agents/session-reader` separately if you want to browse and continue existing Claude, Cod
ex or Grok histories. See the DSH user guide, service and A2A guide, and installation verification.

led `0.2.0-rc.1`; they show discovery and native capability loading, without sending a model prompt.
The CI baseline is **DSH 0.1.7-rc.2**, commit `21638c5`. See the verification record for the instal
led-artifact, profile, Loader, browser and lifecycle checks. Compatibility with other releases requi
res checking their plugin APIs.
The plugin currently accepts text prompts. Available controls depend on the selected native Agent, a
y accepts text prompts. Available controls depend on the selected native Agent, adapter and account.
## Standalone CLI
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The runtime and service can be used outside DSH. Installing the npm package starts no process.
## Source workspace
One published package contains the runtime, CLI, service and DSH plugin. The upstream runtime and DS
H plugin remain private source modules in one repository with one pnpm lockfile. The DSH plugin comm
unicates with the service through ACP JSON-RPC, while a managed child process loads the service when
a local endpoint needs starting.
Project-owned roles, skill caches, workspaces and runtime state live under `.1agents/`. Role definit
ions and public examples are tracked; local data and credentials are excluded from Git.
| Directory             | npm package            | Responsibility
| `packages/runtime`    | Private workspace only | Upstream agent runtime and CLI, embedded in the s

ervice                      |
| `packages/service`    | `@1agents/acp-service` | ACP CLI/service, A2

A delegation and bundled usage skill                     |
| `packages/dsh-plugin` | private source
module | DSH session presets, native commands, model selection and interactions       |
## Development
Use Node 24 and the pnpm version pinned in package.json. Install from this root; package-level npm l
ockfiles are replaced by the root pnpm lockfile.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Build runtime, then service, then the private DSH source module; `pnpm build` also embeds the DSH ho
st entry, browser bundle and patch into the service. Consumers can import `@1agents/acp-service/runt
ime`, `@1agents/acp-service/flows` and `@1agents/acp-service/agent-registry`, or use the unified `ac
p-service` CLI. The DSH development links supply types only; the Host provides those services at run
vice` CLI. The DSH development links supply types only; the Host provides those services at runtime.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Agent binaries, authentication, service state and DSH session bindings remain outside this repositor
y. Moving the checkout does not migrate or delete session data.
## Package releases
Only `@1agents/acp-service` is published. Version 0.7.0 includes the runtime, CLI, service and DSH p
lugin in one tarball. Runtime and DSH source modules stay private; there is one public version to bu
mp and one package to publish.
Version 0.7.0 adds Activepieces scheduled tasks through the existing A2A gateway, with durable occur
rence admission, result claims and acknowledgement. Codex commentary stays in DSH execution logs whi
le A2A reports contain the final answer; explicit empty answers survive replay. The scheduled-chain
verification records the completed WSL deployment test.
Version 0.6.0 adds DSH A2A 1.0 execution, remote-agent gateway tools, a durable completion inbox and
the bundled ACP Service usage skill. Tasks return IDs before completion, run in the selected remote
workspace and preset, and support standard queries, subscriptions and allowed completion callbacks.
The gateway reconciles remote status after reconnect or restart; main-model wake-up still requires
a receiving host adapter.
